intervals.label: proposal and design studies
intervals.note: Month from the 2026 project talk (2011.12); Physics World says it was first proposed in 2011 by Zhao Guangda. Design documents: Physics & Detector CDR (arXiv:2303.15790, 2023), accelerator CDR (arXiv:2509.11522, 2025). The accelerator CDR 'aims to secure support from the Chinese central government for its construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030)'; the June 2026 talk says the proposal was submitted in 2025 and defended for inclusion in that plan. No approval is reported in the sources fetched (as of 2026-10-26).
intervals.quote: Proposed at “workshop for acc. Based high energy physics development strategy”

lineage.note: The article names the accelerator (BEPC); the Atlas maps the predecessor relation onto BESIII, the experiment at BEPCII. The STCF Physics & Detector CDR compares the STCF with 'the present τ-Charm factory — the BEPCII'.
lineage.quote: The STCF is seen as a natural successor to the Beijing Electron Positron Collider (BEPC)

name: STCF
notes: Proposed only: the 2023 Physics & Detector CDR and the 2025 accelerator CDR are design reports; the host site (Hefei Future Big Science City) is named by the STCF working group's talks, not by a decision. No approval is reported in the sources fetched.

physics_goals.quote: providing a unique platform for exploring the asymmetry of matterantimatter (charge-parity violation), in-depth studies of the internal structure of hadrons and the nature of non-perturbative strong interactions, as well as searching for exotic hadrons and physics beyond the Standard Model.
physics_goals.value: Tau-charm physics at 2 to 7 GeV: charmonium and XYZ states, charmed hadrons, tau physics, CP violation, hadron structure and searches for physics beyond the Standard Model

summary.plain: The detector and collaboration for the proposed Super Tau-Charm Facility in Hefei, China, a collider planned to make tau leptons and charm hadrons at 2 to 7 GeV, about 100 times more than BESIII, to study exotic hadrons, CP violation and new physics. It is in design and R&D.
summary.technical: STCF: proposed spectrometer for √s = 2 to 7 GeV e⁺e⁻ collisions (peak luminosity above 0.5×10³⁵ cm⁻² s⁻¹) with a µRWELL or CMOS-pixel inner tracker, drift chamber, RICH and DIRC-like TOF particle identification, pure CsI electromagnetic calorimeter, 1 T superconducting solenoid and RPC muon system, 94% of 4π; Physics & Detector CDR with 82 institutions and 453 authors (arXiv:2303.15790).
